d:
Babita gets bombarded with 44 missed calls and 28 text messages overnight, Iyer refuses to go to the police and instead visits Taarak, heavily hinting that he suspects Jethalal is behind it. Taarak defends his friend, advising Iyer not to make accusations without solid proof.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
